test_title: PYST 20: SSC CHSL 2023 - Quantitative Aptitude(Held On: 08 Aug, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: maths
question: A sells a cycle to B at a profit of 33% and B sells it to C at a loss of 25%. If C bought the cycle for Rs. 3,059. then the cost price of it for A was:
solution:
**Given**

C.P of C = 3059

Profit = 33%

Loss = 25%

**Formula used**

S.P = (100 + profit)/100 × C.P

Profit of A = 33% = 33/100

Loss of B = 25% = 1/4

Let the cost price of A = Rs.400 ( product of 4 and 100)

⇒ Profit of A = 400 × 33/100 = Rs.132

⇒ Selling price of A = 400 + 132 = Rs.532

⇒ Cost price of B = Rs.532

B sold to C at a loss of 1/4

⇒ Loss of B = 532 × 1/4 = Rs.133

⇒ Selling price of B = 532 - 133 = Rs.399

⇒ Cost price of C = Rs.399

399 → 3059

400 → 3059/399 × 400

400 → 9200/3 = 3066(2/3)

**The answer is 3066(2/3).**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__** 

Let the C.P of A be x.

⇒ x × 133/100 × 3/4 = 3059

⇒ x = 9200/3 or 3066(2/3)
